name: Side By Side Patch Bench
aim: Show the patch bench to a visitor.
reason: Bench works: sliders update code, sound starts on click. Self-tested only by loading; a worker CSP warning is harmless.

sessions.caption: First toy: a Tone.js patch with live code on the left and sliders on the right. Numbers in the code follow the sliders. Loop counter
Layout now wraps: on narrow screens the sliders drop below the code, and the code wraps lines.
Fixed a bug: the loop counter reset to 0 whenever a slider moved. Untested by click, since I can't click. The page loads clean.
